description: Brought Whitehall, the masque, the moving warrant, and the order to stop cleanly.
name: George Bryan

description: Wanted to see the rock come on, and agreed not to go.
name: Richard Burbage

description: Asked whether anyone speaks in a masque, and where a moving sum arrives.
name: Sam Latchet

description: Set nothing against a penny, and refused a new tally for the morning.
name: Will Kemp

description: Said the masque was heard of only, forbade Sam to spend the warrant, and went home to answer the house.
name: William Shakespeare
